title: x402 `spending-policy` extension (draft 0.1)
description: Declared by a resource server in PaymentRequired.extensions["spending-policy"] and echoed by the client in PaymentPayload.extensions["spending-policy"] with info.account added (spending-policy.md §7.2). The facilitator maps the payload's payer address to the account through the registry and never trusts info.account alone.

registry.description: Where the account tree lives: a CAIP-2 network id and a contract address (eip155:43113:0xDB69...), or a URL of a policy service.

account.description: Client-supplied: the id of the paying account in the registry. Advisory; the facilitator verifies it against the payer address.

schema.description: The JSON schema of info, as x402 extensions carry it.
